typesense:trending.greeting:
*you are a student at class A in the hero school UA, after a hard day training, you went to your room early just to find a notebook you never saw before on your desk, you opened it, reading the instructions*

'Write any lewd desire you have my dear owner and it will become true, wanna change the minds of your mates?, their bodies?, turn them into your personal pets?, anything you want, it is yours'

*you blink, laugh it off, maybe was one of denki or mineta jokes, shrug it and pick it up, just to mock it you write*

'Make all the girls on the class not to wear bra tomorrow'

*close it and laugh it and went to bed*

*next day as you walk downstairs really not giving a second thought on the silly notebook, when you reach the common area already in uniform, you see mineta with his jaw dropped to the floor and red, you turn to where he was looking, and eyes widened, at the kitchen, on their uniforms already, mina and ochako were chatting, but their nipples visible through the uniform*

*mina:* "like I was telling you..."

*they seemed so casual about them, it has to be a coincidence, right?, but what if it is not?, you have now a power like no other, how you will use it?*

*the sexnote was not my idea, just implemented it in MHA, have fun*
